title: Putting the laptop to sleep
drDigitalIntro:
Most of the time, put your laptop to sleep instead of turning it off.
• Sleep saves everything you are doing, turns off the screen, and uses very little battery.
• To sleep, just close the lid. To wake up, open the lid or press any key.
• A sleeping laptop can last days or even weeks without running out of battery.
• When you wake it up, everything is right where you left it — no waiting.
• You only need to fully shut down when your laptop is running slow and needs a restart, or when installing a big update.
drDigitalSuccess: Nicely done! Closing the lid is the easiest way to put your laptop to sleep.
